title: Lentswe Pele ga Sefefo
intro: Setshwantsho sengwe mo sekakeng se ne sa tsoga go bitsa setšhaba se se maatla gore se boele mo boammaaruring. Batho ba ne ba itsege ka dikago tsa bone tse dintlentle le maatla a bone a a senang selekanyo. Le fa go ntse jalo boikgogomoso jwa bone jwa ba foufatsa, mme ba gana go reetsa. Kgabagare, ba ne ba welwa ke kotlhao e e botlhoko, ba boloka fela setlhopha se sennye sa badumedi.
clues: Ke ne ka romelwa kwa bathong ba ba nonofileng ba ba neng ba nna mo dinageng tse di bulegileng mme ba itsege ka maatla a bone.
Batho ba me ba ne ba tla morago ga morafe o mongwe o mogolo o o neng o nyeleditswe.
Ba ne ba na le dikago tse dintlentle mme ba aga ditora tse di kwa godimo.
Ke ne ka ba bitsa go obamela Modimo o le Mongwe fela, mme ba ne ba gana go tlogela medingwana ya bone.
Kotlhao e e bogale e ne ya ba wela, ya boloka fela ba ba neng ba dumela le nna.
Ke nna yo o rometsweng kwa bathong ba ba maatla ba ba bidiwang Aad.

arabic: أَوَعَجِبْتُمْ أَن جَآءَكُمْ ذِكْرٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍۢ مِّنكُمْ لِيُنذِرَكُمْ ۚ وَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ إِذْ جَعَلَكُمْ خُلَفَآءَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ قَوْمِ نُوحٍۢ وَزَادَكُمْ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ بَصْۜطَةًۭ ۖ فَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ ءَالَآءَ ٱللَّهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
verse: Then do you wonder that there has come to you a reminder from your Lord through a man from among you, that he may warn you? And remember when He made you successors after the people of Noah and increased you in stature extensively. So remember the favors of Allāh that you might succeed." (7:69)
